chunks: When it is said to them, 'Believe as others believe,' they say, 'Should we believe like the fools?' Indeed, they are the fools, but they do not know.

key_terms.السُّفَهَاءُ: The fools (those considered simple-minded by others)

ai.seo_question: Who are the fools mentioned in Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological arrogance of the hypocrites (al-Munafiqun) who equate sincere submission with naivety, revealing their own spiritual blindness. The phrase 'but they do not know' underscores their lack of insight into the true nature of faith, a theme frequently elaborated upon by Imams like Ali ibn Abi Talib in distinguishing between superficial conformity and deep conviction. This dynamic serves as a critical lesson for the community to recognize that true wisdom lies in humble acceptance of divine guidance rather than intellectual pride.
